review_artifact.root_cause: The Idempotency-Key reached submit_job but was ignored; every request unconditionally created a new stored job before any simulated response interruption, so retrying after persistence created a duplicate. Without atomic lookup-and-create, concurrent requests using the same key could also duplicate jobs.
review_artifact.behavior_fixed: submit_job now uses a lock-protected get-or-create operation keyed by Idempotency-Key. The store records the key-to-job association before timeout simulation, returns the original job for retries, creates distinct jobs for distinct keys, serializes concurrent same-key creation, and clears idempotency state during reset.

verification_performed.description: Compared the repaired application with the pristine reference and inspected the complete changed-file set.
Ran the visible pytest suite with capture and cache disabled after the initial invocation was blocked by the read-only environment's lack of a writable temporary directory.
Ran focused endpoint and store assertions covering normal creation, persistence before an interrupted response, same-key retry, different keys, concurrent same-key requests, and store reset.

verification_results.description: The visible suite passed: 1 passed in 1.62 seconds.
All focused contract checks passed, including retry deduplication and atomic same-key concurrency.
The final verifier passed attempt 1 and found the production source change scoped to app/service.py and app/store.py.

review_artifact.remaining_risk: Idempotency state remains process-local and in-memory, so it does not survive restarts or coordinate multiple worker processes. Behavior for reusing one key with a different payload is unspecified and currently returns the original job. Generated __pycache__ files are present in the actual diff and should not be included in a source change.
review_artifact.human_review_action: Review the lock-protected key lookup/create implementation and confirm that process-local idempotency and returning the original job for a reused key with a different name match the intended scope. Exclude the generated __pycache__ files before approval. Do not merge or deploy until hidden evaluation is complete.
